principle: Generate ratios only from explicit recipes. Every recipe names numerator, denominator, unit conversions, period policy and boundary policy; no blind Cartesian product of evidence.

boundaryPolicies.near_match: Boundaries are close enough for an exploratory ratio but the mismatch must remain visible.
boundaryPolicies.cross_boundary: Different boundaries are intentionally combined to expose structure; never render as harmonized score.

periodPolicies.near_period: Adjacent/mixed periods allowed only with explicit warning.
periodPolicies.mixed_explicit: Different periods are intentional and must be labelled.

rabbitHoleHeuristics.note: Thresholds are discovery heuristics, not value judgments. A flag asks a question; it does not rank entities.
